skins.name: Dojo Star
skins.description: MARTHE Sports Line. A limited-edition outfit commemorating FEater's 3rd Anniversary of setting the box office record. Lightweight, breathable, and comfortably-fitting. However, anyone who knows FEater also knows that she has never worn this outfit properly.

skins.name: Caster's Frost
skins.code: Pramanix's Tailor-Made Outfit by Savile/Caster's Frost
skins.description: A full set of hand-made clothing that perfectly fits the wearer's body shape, with additional details to her lifestyle.

skins.name: Cheerful Guardian
skins.description: Lightweight, comfortable, full of wintry motifs, but not cold-resistant at all. Cardigan is a bit afraid of the cold, but in front of a bag of gifts and her favorite sled, the temperature stops seeming so important.
skins.howToObtain: Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: Presents
skins.description: Some elements of this outfit run antithetical to the holiday spirit, but she hasn't seemed to notice. More important things are on her mind.

skins.name: York's Bise
skins.code: SilverAsh's Tailor-Made Outfit by Savile/York's Bise
skins.description: The expensive fabrics are as cold-resistant as possible while still ensuring comfort. Combined with a special scarf to reflect the discerning taste of the tailor.
